results.title: rollup virtual module bundle

results.title: Generate TypeScript types from JSON Schema with json-schema-to-typescript
results.summary: Compile JSON Schemas into TypeScript interfaces with json-schema-to-typescript, covering required and optional fields, enums, $ref definitions, descriptions as JSDoc and strict additionalProperties.

results.title: openapi-typescript generate types
results.summary: Generate TypeScript types from an inline OpenAPI 3.1 document with the openapi-typescript programmatic API using openapiTS and astToString, asserting generated interface members and path keys offline.

results.title: Excel .xlsx export and import with ExcelJS
results.summary: Generate styled .xlsx reports (header row, number formats, formulas, frozen panes) and read uploaded workbooks back into typed rows with ExcelJS, all in memory.

results.title: CSV import with PapaParse + Zod row validation
results.summary: Parse CSV uploads with PapaParse (headers, BOM, quoted fields), validate each row with Zod and report row-numbered errors instead of failing the whole file.

results.title: Anthropic TypeScript SDK tool use loop, tested with a mocked fetch
results.summary: Run a Claude tool_use loop with the official Anthropic SDK and Zod-validated tool inputs, tested offline with an injected fetch.

results.title: openpyxl worksheet rows validated into pydantic models offline
results.summary: Read xlsx rows from openpyxl into pydantic v2 models, handling None cells, whole-float to int coercion, whitespace, ignored extra columns and row-numbered errors, all tested offline.

results.title: ts-morph code generation and AST codemods in memory
results.summary: Generate a typed TypeScript client module with ts-morph structures, type-check it with pre-emit diagnostics, and run codemods (cross-file rename, var to const, strip console.log) on an in-memory file system.

results.title: esbuild build API bundling virtual files in memory (write:false)
results.summary: Bundle TypeScript from an in-memory file map with an esbuild resolve/load plugin and write:false, use define, tree shaking, minify and external source maps, evaluate the bundle, and assert structured build errors.

results.title: Fuse.js fuzzy search with weighted keys and a prebuilt index
results.summary: Fuzzy search a product list with Fuse.js using weighted title/brand/tag keys, match metadata, and a serialized prebuilt index, fully offline.
